title: Reliability program (Q1): MTTR KPI targets + reporting cadence
creator: Marissa Cole
body:
Goal
Stand up the Q1 Reliability Program KPI tracking for MTTR (mean time to restore) with clear targets, a lightweight weekly reporting cadence, and a consistent measurement definition across incident types. This ticket is the single source-of-truth for (a) targets, (b) how we measure, (c) who reports, and (d) where it’s published.

Context
We’re running the “Incident bot + diagnostics improvements” initiative to reduce MTTR and repeat incidents by improving automated incident context in Slack (#incidents, #eng-oncall). Leadership alignment (Neha Kapoor thread) asked for: (1) explicit MTTR targets by incident class, (2) a plan to measure before/after for the v2 bot rollout, and (3) a weekly readout that SRE + Platform can action.

Scope
- Define MTTR KPI(s) and supporting metrics (time-to-triage, time-to-mitigation, context completeness score).
- Establish baseline + targets for Q1 (end-of-quarter).
- Define reporting cadence + artifact locations (weekly post + monthly rollup).
- Define beta vs GA measurement plan for Incident Bot v2 (feature-flagged cohorts).

Out of scope
- Changing incident process / severity definitions.
- Building a full analytics pipeline beyond minimal instrumentation (that work lives with SRE/Telemetry tickets).

Definitions (proposed; confirm with SRE)
Primary KPI: MTTR
- Definition: time from “incident declared” timestamp to “customer impact resolved” timestamp (or mitigation applied) for Sev0/Sev1 only.
- Segmentation: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private; by region for Hosted; by primary incident class where possible.

Supporting metrics
1) Time-to-triage (TTT)
- Definition: incident declared → first confirmed suspected cause OR first action that materially narrows scope (e.g., rollback initiated, config revert proposed).
- Goal: improve early decisions; should correlate with bot context improvements.

2) Time-to-mitigation (TTM)
- Definition: incident declared → mitigation started (rollback, failover, routing policy change, capacity add).
- Used to detect if we’re faster at taking safe mitigation steps.

3) Context completeness score (CCS)
- Definition: binary per incident thread for whether bot output contained the standard “first 5 minutes” cards:
  - Recent deploy context present (service/version/rollout phase/canary)
  - Customer/tenant-safe config diff present (feature flags/routing/quota/model pins) OR explicit reason unavailable
  - Saturation signals present (GPU util/queue depth/KV cache pressure/backpressure) OR explicit reason unavailable
- Score: 0–3 (or % completeness) recorded per incident, per environment.

4) Repeat incident rate (directional)
- Definition: count of incidents tagged as “repeat within 30 days” (manual classification initially; may be automated later).
- Note: included for narrative; not a Q1 gating KPI unless SRE confirms tagging quality.

Baseline + Q1 targets (initial proposal)
NOTE: final numbers depend on baseline extraction from the MTTR sheet + SRE confirmation.
- Sev0/Sev1 overall MTTR: -20% by end of Q1 (vs Feb baseline)
- Deploy regression incidents: -30% MTTR (bot “Recent deploys” card expected to drive largest wins)
- Misconfig / routing policy incidents: -25% MTTR (config diff + redaction + deep links)
- Regional capacity/saturation incidents: -20% MTTR (standardized saturation cards + dashboard links)

Measurement plan
A) Before/after by rollout cohort
- Phase 1 (beta): SRE rotation only, limited regions (feature flag)
- Phase 2 (GA): broaden to all on-call rotations
- Compare MTTR/TTT/TTM for incidents where the bot v2 cards were present vs absent, controlling for severity and service where possible.

B) Guardrails
- Ensure bot does not increase incident load (telemetry query timeouts, self-inflicted latency). Track:
  - bot context generation p95 latency
  - bot degraded-mode rate (fallback to cached context + links)

Reporting cadence + artifact locations
Weekly (every Monday by EOD PT)
- Owner: Paula Mendes (PM), with Rafael Mendes (SRE delivery lead) as reviewer.
- Channel: #eng-sre and #reliability-program
- Format: 6-bullet “KPI pulse”
  1) Sev0/Sev1 incident count last week
  2) MTTR median and p75 (overall + top 2 services/areas)
  3) Breakdown by incident class (deploy/misconfig/saturation)
  4) Context completeness score distribution
  5) Notable wins/learns (1–2 items)
  6) Risks/blockers + next week focus

Monthly (first week of next month)
- Owner: Sean Gallagher (exec sponsor) signs off on the rollup; PM prepares.
- Deliverable: 1-pager summary for leadership + Reliability Program KPI tracker update.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] SRE confirms MTTR/TTT/TTM definitions and which severities are in-scope.
- [ ] Q1 targets finalized and posted in the Reliability Program tracker.
- [ ] Weekly KPI pulse template published and first two weekly updates posted.
- [ ] CCS (context completeness score) definition finalized and instrumented plan agreed (links to ENG tickets / owners).
- [ ] Rollout cohort plan (beta vs GA) tied to measurement approach and explicitly documented here.

Stakeholders
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (exec sponsor), Rafael Mendes (delivery lead), Aisha Bello (SLOs/alerting)
- Platform: Priya Natarajan (sponsor)
- Telemetry/Obs: Logan Wright, Allison Grant

Open questions
- Do we measure MTTR by “mitigation applied” or “fully resolved” for all Sev1s? (Some incidents have long tail clean-up.)
- What is the canonical incident declared timestamp? (Pager trigger vs Slack “/incident declare” action.)
- Can we reliably tag incident class (deploy vs config vs saturation) at declaration time, or only postmortem time?

Latest updates
- 2025-02-18: Drafted baseline/targets proposal; waiting on SRE confirmation of MTTR definition + severity scope.
- 2025-02-24: Added CCS proposal aligned to Incident Bot v2 cards; needs sign-off from Miles/Jacob on logging fields.
- 2025-03-05: Weekly KPI pulse template reviewed with Rafael; first readout scheduled for next Monday once CCS logging is live in beta cohort.

Related work / links (by key)
- PM-311: Incident bot v2 user stories + success metrics
- ENG-5428: v2 rollout + feature flag plan
- ENG-5431: docs/runbook updates needed for GA

Notes
This ticket should stay lightweight and operational. If we need new dashboards or query plumbing, spin out ENG issues and link them here; avoid turning this into an analytics rebuild.
